C1204.title: Shanghai Digital-Human Livestream Franchise Failed to Deliver Promised Service
C1204.summary: In April 2024, Guancha.cn cited a Xinmin Evening News report about several Shanghai residents who joined an 'AI intelligent system' franchise run by a cultural-media company. The promised round-the-clock digital-human livestreaming could not be delivered because of technical and operational problems. One participant said that after investing tens of thousands of yuan and operating for more than half a year, total income by the end of 2023 was only 167.83 yuan and the franchise fee had not been refunded.
